scope: All registered SkyN3t skill records, including all quarantined records.
rating_method: Independent qualitative reading of each local body; usefulness to SkyN3t, not source-repository quality or runtime-success score.

rating_scale.1: No reusable build instruction or wrong fit as a standalone skill.
rating_scale.3: Useful scoped advice, but incomplete or missing validation.
rating_scale.4: Strong actionable reusable procedure with minor gaps.
rating_scale.5: Excellent self-contained scoped procedure with explicit verification and failure handling.

limits: Ratings are reasoned editorial judgments, not measured performance benchmarks.
Highest-rated short excerpts and summaries were calibrated for missing verification and unsafe standalone instructions.
No live skill, score sidecar, quarantine tag, dependency, or runtime configuration was changed.
No installed source has its original upstream revision/hash; recovered origins are audit evidence, not retroactive trust receipts.
Matching a retained README excerpt does not establish currency of the whole repository, dependencies, APIs, or unseen documentation.
An excerpt no longer found in the current README indicates source drift requiring review, not automatically obsolete technical advice.
HTTP 200 for a cited summary is source accessibility, not proof of semantic freshness.
Archived repositories are reported separately; unchanged archived text is not proof of maintained guidance.
Missing sources and insufficient evidence stay explicit unknowns rather than being marked current.
